title: Adjournment Motion on fire safety in homes
what_it_is: An Adjournment Motion where a Non-Constituency Member spoke on fire safety in homes and the Minister of State for Home Affairs responded.
why_it_matters: The Minister said the Land Transport and Related Matters Bill was introduced for First Reading, which makes it an offence to keep unsafe devices such as non-UL2272 certified e-scooters. He also said MOT targets legislative amendments later this year to strengthen regulations on online sale of AMDs. The record does not set out other practical impacts of the proposals raised.

key_points.point: Fire fatalities rose from three in 2023 to five in 2024.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: Fire fatalities rose from three in 2023 to five in 2024.

key_points.point: By August 2025, at least eight fire deaths had been recorded.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: by August 2025, we had already recorded at least eight fire deaths.

key_points.point: Proposed making installation of new entrance gates with an interior thumb turn an "essential improvement" under the HIP scheme, fully subsidised and not optional.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: we should make the installation of new entrance gates with an interior thumb turn an "essential improvement" under the HIP scheme, fully subsidised and not optional.

key_points.point: Proposed eliminating wrought iron gates with double cylinder locks as an option.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: Wrought iron gates with double cylinder locks should also be eliminated as an option.

key_points.point: Proposed encouraging or mandating pre-installation by developers of gates with single cylinder thumb-turn locks.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: we should encourage or even mandate that the pre-installation by developers of gates with single cylinder thumb-turn locks.

key_points.point: Proposed a phased replacement plan for legacy gates with double cylinder locks for estates not set to have an HIP exercise in the near future, prioritising older estates.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: We should also develop a phased replacement plan for legacy gates with double cylinder locks for estates that are not set to have an HIP exercise in the near future, prioritising older estates.

key_points.point: Proposed incorporating risks of keyed gates, additional padlocks and sealed window grilles into public education campaigns on fire safety.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: we should incorporate the risks of keyed gates, additional padlocks and sealed window grilles into public education campaigns on fire safety.

key_points.point: AMD fires rose 21.8% in 2024 to 67 cases while PMA fires saw a 120% spike.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: Active mobility device (AMD) fires rose 21.8% in 2024 to 67 cases while personal mobility aid (PMA) fires saw a dramatic 120% spike.

key_points.point: Proposed pushing for battery swapping systems to be commonplace.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: I think we should push for battery swapping systems to be commonplace

key_points.point: Proposed building public charging hubs for AMDs, perhaps co-located with EV chargers in HDB car parks.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: I propose that we build public charging hubs for AMDs, perhaps co-located with electric vehicle (EV) chargers in HDB car parks.

key_points.point: Proposed implementing periodic inspections of AMDs, especially batteries, with enforced replacement timelines as batteries degrade and age.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: I would suggest that we implement periodic inspections of AMDs, especially batteries, with enforced replacement timelines as batteries degrade and age.

key_points.point: Proposed considering "Fire Escape Viability" – presence of single-point egress or enclosed corridors – as one factor in Voluntary Early Redevelopment Scheme selection for flat redevelopment.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: we should consider "Fire Escape Viability" – presence of single-point egress or enclosed corridors – as one factor in Voluntary Early Redevelopment Scheme selection for flat redevelopment.

key_points.point: Proposed further expanding the installation of Home Fire Alarm Devices (HFAD) to all older flats.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: I propose that we further expand the installation of the Home Fire Alarm Devices (HFAD) to all older flats.

key_points.point: Proposed rolling out sprinkler systems in common areas of older blocks systematically, not just as pilots.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: we should roll out sprinkler systems in common areas of older blocks systematically, and not just as pilots.

key_points.point: Proposed implementing more rigorous inspection regimes for fire-fighting infrastructure – wet risers, dry risers, booster pumps – with published compliance rates and mandatory remediation timelines.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: we should implement more rigorous inspection regimes for fire-fighting infrastructure – wet risers, dry risers, booster pumps – with published compliance rates and mandatory remediation timelines.

key_points.point: Proposed supporting Town Councils with clearer enforcement mandates, and more monetary resources and support to maintain safety standards and keep fire safety infrastructure in good working order.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: we should support our Town Councils with clearer enforcement mandates, and more monetary resources and support to maintain the safety standards and keep fire safety infrastructure in good working order.

key_points.point: Corrected the fatality figure: six in the whole of 2025.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: We had six in the whole of 2025.

key_points.point: Residential fire situation is stable over the past five years, with fatalities fewer than six on average per year.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: The number of fatalities has also remained low, fewer than six on average per year in the past five years.

key_points.point: Top three causes of residential fires in Singapore have been unattended cooking fires, fires of electrical origin, and naked flames such as candles.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: the top three causes of residential fires in Singapore have been unattended cooking fires, which account for about a third of cases, fires of electrical origin and those arising from naked flames, such as candles.

key_points.point: Fire compartmentalisation principle is effective.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: this fire compartmentalisation principle is effective.

key_points.point: On locks, there is a trade-off with practicality, and security is something Singaporeans prioritise and value.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: we often have to trade off practicality as well. In this regard, security is also something that I think Singaporeans will prioritise and value.

key_points.point: The Fire Code is periodically updated.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: the Fire Code is periodically updated.

key_points.point: The introduction of more recent Fire Code provisions does not mean that older flats are unsafe.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: the introduction of more recent Fire Code provisions does not mean that older flats are unsafe

key_points.point: Older point blocks require a single exit staircase as stipulated by the Fire Code then, and based on risk analysis this is wearable because there are only a few units per floor, so the number of evacuees is much reduced.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: The older point blocks require a single exit staircase as stipulated by the Fire Code then, and based on the risk analysis, we believe that is wearable because there are only a few units per floor, so the number of evacuees are much reduced.

key_points.point: There is a regular annual inspection regime for dry risers to make sure they are functional.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: Currently, we do have a regular annual inspection regime for these dry risers to make sure they are functional

key_points.point: Since 2018, HFADs have been mandatory in all new homes.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: Since 2018, HFADs have been mandatory in all new homes.

key_points.point: As of June last year, close to 200,000 HDB flats already have HFADs installed across Singapore through subsidised schemes.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: as of June last year, close to 200,000 HDB flats already have HFADs installed across Singapore through our subsidised schemes.

key_points.point: AMDs accounted for less than 5% of residential fires over the past five years, but more than 10% of fire-related injuries and 25% of fatalities.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: Even though AMDs accounted for less than 5% of residential fires over the past five years, they accounted for more than 10% of fire-related injuries and 25% of fatalities.

key_points.point: Between 2022 and 2025, more than 70% of AMD-related residential fires involved devices that were either not certified or tested to the relevant standards or had been illegally modified.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: Between 2022 and 2025, of all AMD-related residential fires, more than 70% involved devices that were either not certified or tested to the relevant standards or had been illegally modified.

key_points.point: In the last five years, LTA detected over 5,000 cases of non-compliant AMDs and took action against offenders including riders, owners and retailers.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: In the last five years, LTA detected over 5,000 cases of non-compliant AMDs and took action against offenders including riders, owners and retailers.

key_points.point: The Ministry of Transport earlier today introduced the Land Transport and Related Matters Bill for the First Reading, which makes it an offence to keep unsafe devices such as non-UL2272 certified e-scooters.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: the Ministry of Transport (MOT) earlier today, introduced the Land Transport and Related Matters Bill for the First Reading. This Bill makes it an offence to keep unsafe devices, such as non-UL2272 certified e-scooters.

key_points.point: MOT is looking to strengthen regulations on the online sale of AMDs and targets to make the necessary legislative amendments later this year.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: MOT is also looking to strengthen regulations on the online sale of AMDs and targets to make the necessary legislative amendments later this year.

key_points.point: The Active Mobility Fire Safety Taskforce, co-chaired by LTA and SCDF, will continue to outreach to AMD owners under the Be Device-Safe programme.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: the Active Mobility Fire Safety Taskforce, co-chaired by LTA and SCDF, will continue to outreach to AMD owners under the Be Device-Safe programme

key_points.point: The Sitting tomorrow will commence at 12.00 pm.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: Pursuant to Standing Order 2(3)(a), I wish to inform hon Members that the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 12.00 pm.

what_happens_next: The Land Transport and Related Matters Bill was introduced for First Reading; MOT targets legislative amendments later this year. Parliament adjourned; the next Sitting is tomorrow at 12.00 pm.
not_said: Will the Government adopt the Member's proposals on HIP gates, battery swapping, public charging hubs, periodic inspections, sprinklers, and Town Council support?
What is the timeline for the review of existing fire safety regulations governing building construction and maintenance work?
How will the Land Transport and Related Matters Bill be enforced, and what penalties will apply?
Will the frequency of dry riser inspections be increased?
Will HFAD installation be expanded to all older flats?
